subject: Confirmation of Flight Reservation
body: Dear [Name], This is to confirm your flight reservation for your upcoming trip from New York to London. Your flight is scheduled for June 15th at 9:00 AM. Please arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in. If you have any special meal requests or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey and look forward to serving you onboard. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
